No evidence of malicious behavior, data exfiltration, dynamic code fetching, or supply-chain tampering is present. The package follows safe, reproducible practices and does not modify system state beyond installing font files.

There are no scripts, commands, or executable logic in this file—only declarative package metadata. The license is SIL Open Font License (OFL), appropriate for fonts. The package architecture is `any`, which is normal for font packages. All fields align with standard AUR packaging practices, and there is no evidence of obfuscation, network exfiltration, or unauthorized sources.

The source URL uses HTTPS and originates from the project's own upstream (GitHub), which is expected and safe. No git operations like `git pull` appear in this file (as would be relevant in a PKGBUILD), so there is no risk of unchecked runtime updates. Overall, this file presents no security concerns.
